research_history_boundary.known_development_result: the separate dvol_rich_move_follow_v80_p80_h48 price-follow candidate reached 2.47 CAGR/strict-MDD on 29 2023H2 trades and was rejected

mechanism.claim: when Deribit DVOL is unusually rich to Binance BVOL, an efficient one-hour BTCUSDT premium-index displacement identifies the direction in which perpetual demand is transmitting the options-market uncertainty repricing into BTC
mechanism.action: side equals the sign of the completed one-hour premium move
mechanism.why_distinct_from_dvol_price_follow: OPDR excludes BTC price and return from its clock and takes its direction solely from the premium-index path
mechanism.why_distinct_from_psr_pcbr: OPDR has no recenter, compression cage, outside breakout, or terminal-pin condition; the options-volatility disagreement is a required independent state variable

future_dvol_acquisition.availability: join on close_time, never candle open time

causal_feature_contract.hour_label: T is the boundary after a completed UTC hour
causal_feature_contract.bvol: the BTCBVOLUSDT hourly close available at T
causal_feature_contract.dvol: the Deribit DVOL hourly close with close_time exactly T
causal_feature_contract.premium_hour: 60 exact source-valid one-minute premium-index bars in [T-1h,T)
causal_feature_contract.premium_move: last premium close minus first premium open, in bp
causal_feature_contract.premium_path_range: sum of the 60 one-minute high-low ranges, in bp
causal_feature_contract.strict_prior_thresholds: each feature threshold uses only the preceding 720 completed hourly anchors, excludes the current hour, and requires 672 valid joint observations
causal_feature_contract.setup: vol_ratio<=prior q20; abs(premium_move)>=prior q80; premium_efficiency>=prior q70; false-to-true onset only
causal_feature_contract.feature_available_time: max(BVOL T, DVOL T, final premium minute T+1s) = T+1s

execution_contract.hold: 24 elapsed hours, fixed; no stop, take-profit, or dynamic exit
execution_contract.strict_mdd: global/pre-entry HWM, entry cost, conservative funding boundary marks, every held favorable-then-adverse 5m OHLC path, virtual adverse-mark exit cost, and actual exit cost
execution_contract.cagr: full declared calendar including warm-up and idle seconds

mechanism_controls.no_vol_disagreement: retain premium displacement and efficiency only
mechanism_controls.no_premium_efficiency: retain vol disagreement and premium displacement
mechanism_controls.direction_flip: same primary entries with side multiplied by -1
mechanism_controls.extra_latency_1h: same signal and side with entry and exit delayed one hour

rejection_contract.later_failure: reject without threshold, direction, latency, hold, feature, or support-gate repair

rllm_boundary.future_role: after deterministic passage, an LLM may reason over the frozen symbolic vol-disagreement and premium-path state to abstain or size
